evidence.excerpt: We develop this rule on public VideoQA benchmarks and Video Hallucination Diagnosis (VHD), a controlled diagnostic dataset for shared high-confidence errors.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Video-language models can answer multiple-choice questions with high confidence yet be wrong.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On a held-out 963-question HERBench split, the method reduces mean AURC across the three models by 16.64% (95% confidence interval (CI), 12.12 to 22.61%); the smallest model-level gain is 11.39%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Using a labeled target pilot, we compare the original score, defined as the probability assigned to the chosen answer, with a histogram-based gradient-boosting (HGB) score trained on the development datasets and a regularized logistic-regression score trained on the target pilot.
